prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single universally “best” personal injury lawyer for every car wreck — the right attorney depends on the facts of your case, the injuries, and your preferences (trial lawyer vs. negotiator, big firm vs. boutique, etc.). I can, however, help you find the best lawyer for your situation. Below are practical steps, selection criteria, and resources to quickly identify strong candidates in Houston.

How to find the right personal injury lawyer
- Start with credentials: look for experience handling car-accident cases, a strong track record of settlements/trials, and (if present) Texas Board of Legal Specialization certification in Personal Injury Trial Law.
- Reputation and results: review case results, peer-recognition (Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers, Martindale‑Hubbell ratings), and client reviews.
- Free consultation: most PI lawyers offer one — use it to gauge fit, communication style, and experience.
- Fee structure: most work on contingency (no fee unless you recover). Clarify percentage, who pays expenses if you lose, and any caps.
- Accessibility and team: who will handle day-to-day work? How often will they update you?
- Trial experience: if your case may go to court, prefer a lawyer who actually tries cases.
- Check discipline records: verify license and disciplinary history via the State Bar of Texas website.

What to ask at the first meeting
- How many car-accident cases like mine have you handled?
- What are typical outcomes (settlement range, verdicts)?
- Do you take cases to trial? How many trials have you tried recently?
- Who will handle my case day-to-day and how will you communicate?
- What is your fee and how are expenses handled?
- Can you provide references from past clients?

Places to search and verify lawyers
- Super Lawyers (Houston listings)
- Avvo
- Martindale‑Hubbell
- Best Lawyers
- Texas State Bar license lookup
- Houston Bar Association lawyer referral service
- Google Maps/Yelp for local client reviews

If you want, I can:
- Find top-rated Houston personal injury lawyers for car wrecks and compile a shortlist with contact info and recent results.
- Narrow recommendations by ZIP code, injury severity, insurance limits, or whether you want a lawyer who will go to trial.

Tell me your ZIP code or a few details about the crash (injuries, fault, insurance limits) and I’ll pull a tailored short list.
